title: Surreal Bird of Dreams
description: A vibrant blue and orange bird with intricate patterns perches on a glowing green branch in the foreground. Swirling ribbons of purple, pink and yellow smoke flow from the right, carrying silhouetted human figures and floating fruits through a fantastical mountain landscape under a colorful dusk sky with a crescent moon.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a vibrant blue bird with orange and yellow patterned feathers perched on a glowing green branch, swirling ribbons of purple pink and yellow smoke flowing across the scene carrying silhouetted human figures and floating fruits, misty mountains and pine trees in the background, crescent moon in a colorful dusk sky, dreamlike mystical atmosphere, intricate details, vibrant yet dark color palette
